goal: 建立双端 Chickenbro Chat 与 SimC 彻底重构的唯一 current truth、精确本地 keep/delete/migrate 清单、脱敏云端只读盘点、当前架构和生产恢复 runbook。
userValue: 后续身份、Chat、SimC、双端切流和 legacy 删除都从同一份可审阅、可验证、可恢复的清单推进，不会误删正在运行的数据或继续扩展旧产品。
nonGoals: 本阶段不修改 Identity、Chat、SimC、Worker 或客户端业务运行时。
本阶段不安装依赖、不构建或运行本地 SimulationCraft、不部署 candidate、不切换生产流量。
本阶段不写入或删除云端数据库、服务、timer、环境文件、部署目录、静态资源或备份。
本阶段不把只读盘点、HTTP 200、systemd active、测试通过或磁盘统计描述为整体重构完成。

mustChange: deterministic tracked-file disposition rules and generated local inventory
redacted read-only cloud inventory and capacity gate
single current Chickenbro-SimC architecture and production recovery runbook
project state, plan index, owner maps and verification matrix bindings
task-scoped Strict requirement, evidence and manifest
mustNotChange: server/app and apps/mini-taro product runtime behavior
legacy and v2 production ingress, services, timers and database connections
wow_test, wow_v2_candidate, gear evidence databases and all cloud data
Active Manifest, SimulationCraft runtime pointer, Nginx/TLS and credentials
riskUnknown: The 2026-09-02 cloud inventory can drift and must be refreshed read-only before any later mutation.
SSH reachability may prevent a fresh cloud snapshot; unreachable must remain explicit rather than inferred from public HTTP.
The repository contains 2746 tracked files and historical evidence; classification must fail closed on unmatched or multiply matched paths.
evidenceRequired: deterministic local inventory tests with zero unresolved entries and exact file hashes
cloud inventory redaction and capacity-gate tests plus explicit freshness or unreachable status
retained plan-index and local Markdown link coverage
git diff check, local CR and one complete task-scoped Harness packet

engineeringHealth.reason: Phase 1 is limited to local documentation/tooling and read-only redacted inspection; runtime and cloud mutations are explicitly forbidden.

decisionLog.decision: 用户确认书面规格并要求通过持续 Goal 推进整体完成；当前按阶段门禁只执行 Phase 1 控制面。
当前容量快照为根盘约 8.1GB 可用、小于现用数据库约 15GB；后续建库前必须独立清理或扩容，本阶段不做容量 mutation。
